Operations Manager Job at Harmonics Fried Chicken




        
    

        
        Harmonics Fried Chicken, a fast-food company with several outlets in Calabar and expansion plans, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Operations Manager 

Job Location: Cross River, Calabar
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of its outlets, bakery, catering and events activities.
	As a fast-growing Quick-Service Restaurant (QSR) brand with ambitious expansion plans, HFC is looking for a hands-on leader who can ensure smooth operations, maintain high standards, lead teams and continuously improve processes in response to customer and market needs.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee daily operations across HFC’s business units and ensure effective coordination.
	Lead operational teams, driving accountability, productivity and adherence to standards.
	Monitor service and food quality, cleanliness, stock control and operational costs.
	Implement and maintain SOPs and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency.
	Respond quickly to operational challenges and develop practical, creative solutions.
	Monitor operational performance and provide reports and recommendations to management.
	Coordinate operational requirements for catering, events and other special activities.
	Work collaboratively with HR, Finance, Procurement, Stores and other teams.


Requirements


	Minimum of 5 years of experience in operations management or a senior supervisory role, preferably within a restaurant, eatery or QSR environment.
	Strong practical understanding of high-volume restaurant operations, including service, kitchen, stock and daily workflow.
	Proven experience leading teams and managing operational performance.
	Strong knowledge of SOPs, inventory, stock control and cost management.
	Ability to think on their feet, make sound decisions and develop practical, creative solutions to operational challenges.
	Strong attention to detail, communication, organisation and decision-making skills.
	Experience with astructured, reputable QSR or restaurant brand will be an added advantage.


What HFC Is Looking For:


	A hands-on, organised and proactive leaderwho understands customer and market needs and can take ownership of day-to-day operations.
	The ideal candidate should bea good team player, adaptable and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively with others and contribute to HFC’s growth.


Salary
N400,000 - N450,000 monthly. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated Resume in PDF to: [email protected] using “Operations Manager – HFC Calabar” as the subject of the email. 

Please note


	Kindly include your LinkedIn profile URL in the body of the email, as this is a mandatory requirement.
	Applications submitted without a LinkedIn URL may unfortunately not be considered.

Accountant Job at Harvest Feed & Agro Processing




        
    

        
        At Harvest Feed & Agro Processing, we specialize in transforming cassava into high-quality, versatile products for both the food and agricultural industries. Our primary offerings include Venus Cassava "edible" starch and Venus cassava offals, catering to diverse sectors such as food manufacturing, livestock feed production, and organic farming.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Accountant 

Job Location: Ogun
Job Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a competent and detail-oriented Accountant to manage the company's financial records, reporting, reconciliations, tax compliance, inventory accounting, and other financial operations.


Key Responsibilities


	Prepare financial statements and management reports.
	Handle bank, supplier, customer, and account reconciliations.
	Manage accounts payable and receivable. Prepare budgets, cash flow reports, and financial analysis.
	Handle tax computations and statutory compliance. Monitor inventory accounting and financial controls. Support internal and external audits.
	Maintain accurate financial records and documentation.


Requirements


	B.Sc. / HND in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of relevant accounting experience.
	Good knowledge of accounting principles and tax compliance.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software.
	Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.


Added Advantage:


	ACA, ACCA, or ICAN qualification.
	Experience in agro-processing/manufacturing.
	Knowledge of inventory and cost accounting.
	Strong knowledge of Nigerian tax and statutory requirements.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
